title: Code, protocols and results for: Normal-referenced defect evidence for training-free few-shot industrial defect classification with calibrated conformity screening
description: Evaluation code, pre-committed protocols, split lists and result files (with SHA-256 checksums) for the paper "Normal-referenced defect evidence for training-free few-shot industrial defect classification with calibrated conformity screening". The repository README maps every table and figure of the paper to the scripts and result files that produce it.
